exercises.problemHtml:
Breadth beats depth: one or two items per CLO, each answerable in one clause.

This set has 6 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper, or by running the snippet on your own machine), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.

# CLO1–CLO4 in one sitting: Node, Express, Generator, MongoDB

Answer in the answer panel (no code needed).

1. CLO1 — What does http.createServer(handler) do?CLO1 — http.createServer(handler) làm gì?
2. CLO1 — Which call blocks the event loop?CLO1 — Lời gọi nào chặn event loop?
3. CLO2 — In Express, where must app.use((err, req, res, next) => …) go?CLO2 — Trong Express, app.use((err, req, res, next) => …) phải đặt ở đâu?
4. CLO3 — Why does a generated app have both app.js and bin/www?CLO3 — Vì sao app sinh ra có cả app.js lẫn bin/www?
5. CLO4 — A user has thousands of orders. Embed or reference?CLO4 — Một người dùng có hàng nghìn đơn hàng. Nhúng hay tham chiếu?
6. CLO4 — db.products.updateOne({ name: 'Book' }, { $set: { price: 30 } }) returns modifiedCount: 0. Why?CLO4 — db.products.updateOne({ name: 'Book' }, { $set: { price: 30 } }) trả modifiedCount: 0. Vì sao?

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# CLO1–CLO4 in one sitting: Node, Express, Generator, MongoDB — answer key

1. CLO1 — What does http.createServer(handler) do?CLO1 — http.createServer(handler) làm gì?
   Answer: a) Makes a server that calls handler(req, res) for each request
   The handler receives the raw request and response streams.VI: Handler nhận luồng request và response thô.

2. CLO1 — Which call blocks the event loop?CLO1 — Lời gọi nào chặn event loop?
   Answer: d) fs.readFileSync('big.csv') inside a route
   Sync I/O freezes the only thread for everyone.VI: I/O đồng bộ làm đứng luồng duy nhất cho mọi người.

3. CLO2 — In Express, where must app.use((err, req, res, next) => …) go?CLO2 — Trong Express, app.use((err, req, res, next) => …) phải đặt ở đâu?
   Answer: b) After all routes — it catches errors forwarded from above it
   Middleware runs top to bottom.VI: Middleware chạy từ trên xuống.

4. CLO3 — Why does a generated app have both app.js and bin/www?CLO3 — Vì sao app sinh ra có cả app.js lẫn bin/www?
   Answer: c) app.js builds the app; bin/www creates the server and listens on PORT
   Separation of "what the app is" from "how it is served".VI: Tách "app là gì" khỏi "phục vụ nó thế nào".

5. CLO4 — A user has thousands of orders. Embed or reference?CLO4 — Một người dùng có hàng nghìn đơn hàng. Nhúng hay tham chiếu?
   Answer: a) Reference: each order stores the user id — unbounded data is not embedded
   Data that grows without limit is referenced.VI: Dữ liệu lớn không giới hạn thì tham chiếu.

6. CLO4 — db.products.updateOne({ name: 'Book' }, { $set: { price: 30 } }) returns modifiedCount: 0. Why?CLO4 — db.products.updateOne({ name: 'Book' }, { $set: { price: 30 } }) trả modifiedCount: 0. Vì sao?
   Answer: d) No document matched, or the price was already 30
   Check matchedCount to tell the two apart.VI: Xem matchedCount để phân biệt hai trường hợp.

# CLO5–CLO8: REST & Mongoose, authentication, BaaS, templating — answer key

1. CLO5 — await Post.findById(id).populate('author', 'name') returns…CLO5 — await Post.findById(id).populate('author', 'name') trả về…
   Answer: a) The post with author replaced by { _id, name }
   The select argument limits the populated fields.VI: Đối số select giới hạn field được populate.

2. CLO5 — findByIdAndUpdate(id, { price: -5 }) with min: 0 in the schema saves -5. Why?CLO5 — findByIdAndUpdate(id, { price: -5 }) với min: 0 trong schema vẫn lưu -5. Vì sao?
   Answer: c) Updates skip validators unless runValidators: true
   And add { new: true } to get the updated document back.VI: Và thêm { new: true } để nhận lại document đã cập nhật.

3. CLO6 — Sessions or JWT for an API used by a React app on another domain? (the course's choice)CLO6 — Session hay JWT cho API dùng bởi app React ở domain khác? (lựa chọn của môn)
   Answer: b) JWT, because the server stays stateless (token in a header)
   "JWT, because the server stays stateless" — exactly the one-clause answer style.VI: "JWT, vì server không cần lưu trạng thái" — đúng kiểu trả lời một mệnh đề.

4. CLO6 — What belongs in a JWT payload?CLO6 — Cái gì thuộc payload của JWT?
   Answer: c) The user id and role: the payload is readable by anyone
   Anyone holding the token can decode the payload.VI: Ai cầm token cũng giải mã được payload.

5. CLO7 — What does a BaaS provide?CLO7 — BaaS cung cấp gì?
   Answer: d) Ready-made auth, database and storage instead of your own server
   Firebase, Supabase, Atlas App Services.VI: Firebase, Supabase, Atlas App Services.

6. CLO8 — Which template output is safe for text typed by users?CLO8 — Đầu ra template nào an toàn cho chữ người dùng gõ?
   Answer: b) EJS <%= text %> or Handlebars {{text}}
   The escaping forms; raw forms are for server-made HTML only.VI: Các dạng có thoát; dạng thô chỉ cho HTML do server tạo.

# Code reading: trace the request through the middleware

Answer in the answer panel (no code needed).

1. app.use(express.json()); app.use((req, res, next) => { console.log('A'); next(); }); app.use('/api', (req, res, next) => { console.log('B'); next(); }); app.get('/api/me', requireAuth, (req, res) => { console.log('D'); res.json(req.user); }); // requireAuth logs 'C' then calls next() for a valid token app.use((err, req, res, next) => { console.log('E'); res.status(500).end(); });GET /api/me with a VALID token. Order what is printed / sent.GET /api/me với token HỢP LỆ. Sắp những gì được in / gửi.
2. app.get('/api/items/:id', (req, res) => { console.log('1'); res.json({ id: req.params.id }); }); app.get('/api/items/search', (req, res) => { console.log('2'); res.json([]); }); app.use((req, res) => { console.log('3'); res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not found' }); });Two requests: first GET /api/items/search, then GET /api/nope. # Code reading: trace the request through the middleware — answer key

1. app.use(express.json()); app.use((req, res, next) => { console.log('A'); next(); }); app.use('/api', (req, res, next) => { console.log('B'); next(); }); app.get('/api/me', requireAuth, (req, res) => { console.log('D'); res.json(req.user); }); // requireAuth logs 'C' then calls next() for a valid token app.use((err, req, res, next) => { console.log('E'); res.status(500).end(); });GET /api/me with a VALID token. Order what is printed / sent.GET /api/me với token HỢP LỆ. Sắp những gì được in / gửi.
   Answer: m3) A  →  m4) B  →  m1) C  →  m5) D  →  m2) the JSON response (200)
   express.json (no output) → global logger A → the /api-scoped middleware B → requireAuth C → the handler D, which sends 200. The error handler never runs because no error was passed to next.VI: express.json (không in) → logger toàn cục A → middleware giới hạn /api B → requireAuth C → handler D, gửi 200. Error handler không chạy vì không có lỗi nào được đưa vào next.

2. app.get('/api/items/:id', (req, res) => { console.log('1'); res.json({ id: req.params.id }); }); app.get('/api/items/search', (req, res) => { console.log('2'); res.json([]); }); app.use((req, res) => { console.log('3'); res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not found' }); });Two requests: first GET /api/items/search, then GET /api/nope. Order what happens.Hai request: trước GET /api/items/search, sau GET /api/nope. Sắp những gì xảy ra.
   Answer: m1) prints 1 (the :id route matched "search")  →  m3) sends {"id":"search"} with 200  →  m2) prints 3  →  m4) sends 404 {"error":"Not found"}
   First match wins: "/:id" is declared before "/search", so the search route is unreachable — a classic bug to spot in code-reading items. exercises.title: What is the response? Status codes for code you read
exercises.problemHtml:
For each snippet, choose the status the client actually receives.

This set has 1 table. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper, or by running the snippet on your own machine), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.
